snippet.title: Breakout: Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Available now on Steam!

FREE DEMO available on both Steam and Itch!

Experience fast-paced shotgun carnage in this roguelite shooter like no other! Fight through hundreds of procedurally linked combat arenas, upgrade your fighting abilities and destroy an ever increasing number of robotic baddies along the way!

Are you ready to take them on?
